thesis: Mox Pearl made white mana available before the first land drop, allowing removal, lock pieces, and white sideboard cards to arrive a turn earlier without consuming the land play.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The archive follows Pearl through early championship control, Vintage combo, modern control, and Old School constructions, highlighting white's role as both protection and permanent control in powered decks.

playbook.role: Its best use is not simply casting the first available white spell; sequence it so the mana advances the deck's real bottleneck, protects against Wasteland, or leaves colored interaction available while lands perform other jobs.
